candidates.change_summary: Replace return true; with return false; so the function returns false instead of true when the transfer succeeds.
Replace the require in the loop with a no-op by changing require(_s); to ; so a failed inner transferFrom does not revert the whole transaction, allowing the function to complete and return true.
Replace the require(_tos.length > 0) statement with require(false) so transfer always reverts.
Replace the require(_s) statement inside the loop with require(false) so the call always fails on the first iteration.
Remove the require(_s) check so a failed internal call is not caught and the function still returns true.
Replace the return true statement with return false so the function always returns false.
